sentences.span: The last time credit got this wide, in July, the stocks were roughly 15% lower than they are now.
sentences.why: Goldman's Louis Miller's note states the same comparison between credit spread width now and in July, with hyperscaler equities 15% lower at that time.
This is meta-commentary about the pulse's own reporting style, not a market fact or a bank's stance; no source document addresses it.

sentences.span: Hyperscaler CDS just hit a fresh record
sentences.why: CDS (credit default swaps) is literally the cost of insuring debt against default; Goldman's note states it hit a fresh record.

sentences.span: Looking at the high yield project financing bonds, they're trading around $94, down from $101 in the summer.
sentences.why: Exact match on both price levels and timeframe.

sentences.span: the funding costs are now more about levered borrowers, specifically neoclouds, data center project finance, and GPU deals
sentences.why: Quoted from JPMorgan's Credit Trading Desk (Christian Crosby); neoclouds = GPU-capacity renters, GPU deals = chip-purchase deals, matching the sentence's three categories.

sentences.span: all of the cumulative net buying in this group since the start of 2025 by hedge funds has now been reversed
sentences.why: Goldman Prime data shows the entire multi-year net buy was undone in one week (Oct 8-14), i.e. a full reversal, not a trim.

sentences.span: driven by long sales outpacing short sales 3.5 to 1. Put differently, this was mostly longs puking, with shorts merely adding insult to injury.
sentences.why: The AI-specific unwind the sentence is describing (tied to s6) was explicitly driven by selling existing longs, not by adding shorts (longs outpaced shorts 3.5:1 per the same Goldman note). The 213.9%/83rd-percentile gross-leverage figure is real and correctly quoted (GS Garrett weekend prep), but it describes the broader US L/S book, not the AI-specific mechanism, and the sentence's claimed mechanism contradicts the AI-specific source.

sentences.span: VIX +21% at 20 (highest since July); ... VIX futures traded 3.6x the 20d avg
sentences.why: All three figures (VIX +21% to 20, VIX futures 3.6x 20-day average, Cboe index put volume all-time record) are each independently confirmed across multiple Goldman notes.

sentences.span: the "gs panic" started the week with a one handle … it finished the week at 7.4 … one of the sharpest rallies on record
sentences.why: Matches exactly; and Lee Coppersmith's note (20936.meta.json confirms correct name) independently states the 'first real sign of panic in index protection' line.

sentences.span: The bank remains tactically neutral on duration because "rates continue to flip flop between AI slowdown concerns and rising energy costs"
sentences.why: Citi's neutral-duration stance and its stated reason match exactly; Jay Barry's JPMorgan 10s/30s steepener recommendation (21021) profits when 30y yields rise relative to 10y, matching the sentence's description.

sentences.span: markets are pricing the same odds of a Fed hike (17%) as at the start of the week
sentences.why: JPMorgan's note shows Fed-hike odds ending the week unchanged from where they started, i.e. a round trip over the week (five trading days).

sentences.span: headline prices rose 0.6% on the month and 3.7% on the year (vs 3.6% expected), with gasoline up 9.1% and accounting for more than half of the monthly gain, while core rose 0.3%
sentences.why: Exact match on every figure in the sentence.

sentences.span: a hold could provide relief by removing residual near-term hike risk
sentences.why: JPMorgan's briefing discusses the October 28 FOMC decision and states a hold removes residual near-term hike risk, matching the sentence.

sentences.span: When the median stock is 15% off its high and the index 2%... of market breadth remains close to its narrowest level since the Dot-Com Bubble
sentences.why: Both the 15%-off-high figure and the dot-com-era breadth comparison appear in the same Goldman (Ben Snider) note.

sentences.span: For the "catch-up": consumer-facing laggards... Snider wants clients long the "catch-up," hedged with the "catch-down,"... Goldman is sticking with its year-end S&P target of 8,000... and 8,700 over 12 months
sentences.why: Every element (long consumer-facing laggards, hedge with defensive healthcare/staples, short momentum, S&P targets 8,000/8,700) matches Ben Snider's Goldman note.
